lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in multiple semi-parallel horizontal rows. Largest blobs are located on the dorsal-anterior section, transitioning to smaller, more densely packed clusters posteriorly and ventrally.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersecting horizontal rows of blobs, forming a discernible grid-like lattice across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: One prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from light on the dorsal edge to a darker shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Small, low-diameter high-luminance blobs distributed across the visible surface of the dorsal fin, with higher density observed along the posterior edge.
